03

Four people we are paying to reach.

Every ad on the next pages is written for one of them. If an ad doesn't speak to one, it doesn't run.

Both plans

The colour switch

28–40, works at Manyata or Hennur, lives near Thanisandra. Bored of her hair.

“balayage near me”
Taps when she sees a real result and a price she can plan for.

The lunch-hour exec

26–45, office on the Prestige Tech Forest campus or in Whitefield. No time.

“men's haircut varthur”
Taps when the ad says it fits in a lunch hour, a short walk away.

The frizz fighter

22–40, Bengaluru humidity, mornings lost to styling. Compares prices.

“keratin treatment price”
Taps when she sees “from ₹4,999” and smooth hair that lasts months.

The big day

Bride, sister, friend. Wedding, reception, party. Plans 3–8 weeks out.

“bridal hair stylist bangalore”
Taps when she can book a trial and see occasion looks first.

Why this shape

Search gets the most.Someone typing “keratin near me” wants it this week. Cheapest bookings.
No Performance Max at ₹50k.Spread across YouTube, Gmail and Maps, ₹50k is too thin for Google to learn. Wasted.
Meta sells the change.Colour and keratin are visual. A 15-second reel does what a text ad can't.
Each salon gets its own “near me”.Thanisandra and Varthur never bid against each other.

What makes the tap

Her words, in blue.“Balayage” in the search → “Balayage” in the headline. Google bolds the match.
A real number.“From ₹3,299” filters out bargain hunters and reassures everyone else.
Open now, nearby.Address and hours pull from your Google profile automatically.
Three ways in.Call, directions or WhatsApp — straight from the ad, no website needed.
Your salon's name, not just the brand.Other TONI&GUY outlets sit nearby. “Sobha Arcadia” and “Prestige Tech Forest” in every ad stop the mix-up.

The 5-minute bookingAuto-greeting, quick replies, a human closes.

Desk rules

Reply in 5 minutes, 10 am – 9 pm.After 30 minutes, most people have messaged someone else.
Always offer two times.“Saturday 11 or 4:30?” books. “When are you free?” stalls.
Say the “from” price, then the consult.Honest, and it gets them in the chair.
Tag every chat by ad.A WhatsApp label per campaign tells us which ads bring bookings.
Remind the day before.Cuts no-shows. Ask for a Google review after the visit.

What we need from you
  • Plan choice: ₹50,000 or ₹70,000 a month
  • Confirmed “from” prices for colour, keratin, men's, bridal
  • Is the 20-minute consult free? Opening offer: yes or no
  • WhatsApp Business number for each salon, and who answers it
  • Owner access: Google Business Profiles, Ads, GA4, Meta Business
  • Half a day per salon each month for filming, with client consent

Mock-ups are illustrative. Google and Meta draw ads in their own layouts, which change over time. Hours, phone numbers and ratings on live ads come from your Google Business Profile. All prices and offers are approved by you before anything goes live.
